publish.description: Copy these skills into a Git repository so anyone can install them with npx skills add. Only the skill folders are copied. Nothing is sent until you press Publish.
publish.repoHint: It can be public or private. Loadout signs in with your SSH key, your Git credential helper, the token saved in Settings, Backup, or your GitHub CLI sign-in.
publish.checkHint: Check first: Loadout looks at the repository and lists what would change.
publish.private: Tags, agents and backup data are not copied.

plan.title: What would be published
plan.newBranch: The branch {{branch}} is new. It starts from the default branch.
plan.emptyRepo: The repository is empty. {{branch}} is created.

secrets.title_one: This looks like a key or token. Anyone who can read the repository could use it.
secrets.title_other: These look like keys or tokens. Anyone who can read the repository could use them.
secrets.allow: I checked. It is safe to share.

result.title: Published
result.nothing: Nothing to publish. The repository already has these skills as they are.
result.noInstall: Install them from that repository with npx skills add.

clawhub.title: Publish {{name}} to ClawHub
clawhub.description: Upload this skill as a new version on the ClawHub registry, under your handle. Nothing is sent until you press Publish.
clawhub.notYet: Not published yet: it starts at 1.0.0.
clawhub.noToken: No ClawHub token is saved. Add one in Settings, Marketplaces, then come back.
clawhub.tokenProblem: The saved ClawHub token does not work: {{problem}}
clawhub.slugHint: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Names the skill on ClawHub.
clawhub.versionHint: Three numbers, like 1.2.3. Each publish needs a new one.
clawhub.changelogPlaceholder: Shown next to this version on ClawHub.
clawhub.secrets_one: One file looks like it holds a key or token. Anyone could read it on ClawHub.
clawhub.secrets_other: {{count}} files look like they hold a key or token. Anyone could read them on ClawHub.
clawhub.license: I release this version under the {{license}} licence, as {{marketplace}} requires: anyone may use, change and share it, without attribution.
clawhub.donePending: {{ref}}@{{version}} was accepted. It goes public once ClawHub's security scan finishes.

problem.no_skill_file: The skill has no SKILL.md at its top, which ClawHub requires.
problem.no_slug: The name gives no usable slug.
problem.file_too_large: {{file}} is over ClawHub's limit of {{limit}} per file.
problem.total_too_large: The skill is over ClawHub's limit of {{limit}}.

skip.folder_name: Its folder name cannot be used in a repository.
skip.published_elsewhere: The repository already has it in {{folder}}/. Remove that copy first, or publish there.
